about_the_game:
Cristamon is a chill, collectible-focused, 100% free game where you collect stylized creatures called Cristamons, earn crystals passively, and open boosters — without ever spending a single cent.

🎮 You select an active Companion from your card collection: the rarer the card, the more crystals it generates automatically.
💎 Those crystals can be spent in mini-games to win HexaCristals used to buy Boxes, which contain boosters.
🕓 You’ll also receive one free booster every 30 minutes, with increasing chances of rarity up to the Master level.

📦 Boosters, Boxes, and Collection

Each Box contains 2 boosters.
Each booster contains 3 random Cristamon cards, with 7 levels of rarity:

  • Normal, Common, Uncommon, Rare, Ultra Rare, Mythic, Legendary

Some cards can also appear in special variants:

  • Prismatic, Divine Power, Black/White, Diamond...

  • And the rarest of all: God

🎁 A daily purchase limit allows you to buy:

  • 10 Basic Boxes

  • 10 Basic Plus Boxes

  • 10 Premium Boxes

  • 5 Deluxe Boxes

  • 5 Master Boxes

🚫 Zero microtransactions. Zero traps.

Cristamon is a fully free game with no premium currency, no hidden purchases, and no paid lootboxes.
All cards are earned strictly through gameplay — whether it’s through your Companion’s passive income, your free boosters, or the daily boxes.

There is no real-money withdrawal system, but each card is a Steam item that you can trade or sell on the Market if you choose to.

📅 A living world, without frustration

Every card edition is unique and time-limited: once it ends, it never returns.
Temporary events will regularly bring special content — some might come back, some might not.

💬 A sincere vision

Cristamon is a game made by a player, for players.
No pressure. No shady monetization. No manipulative systems behind a cute interface.

All major decisions about the game are discussed and voted on with the community via Discord.
The goal is simple: to create a game that’s transparent, healthy, fun, and 100% player-respectful.
